profile.name: Rodolphe Salako
profile.heroDescription: Business Development and Sales professional with experience across the iGaming, Web3, real estate, and financial services industries. Skilled in B2B sales, strategic partnership management, market expansion, lead generation, and affiliate management across international markets.
profile.aboutTagline: Connecting People. Building Partnerships. Driving Growth. Dedicated to identifying business opportunities, B2B sales, developing strategic partnerships, leading affiliate networks, and driving commercial expansion across iGaming, Web3, real estate, and financial services.
aboutParagraphs: I'm Rodolphe Salako, a Business Development and Sales professional with experience across the iGaming, Web3, real estate, and financial services industries.

My work focuses on identifying business opportunities, developing strategic B2B partnerships, lead generation, market expansion, and affiliate management. I also bring extensive experience in team leadership, event coordination, social media, and community management across international markets.

I'm passionate about connecting businesses, building valuable alliances, developing commercial networks, and accelerating growth across the digital industry. Connecting People. Building Partnerships. Driving Growth.
profile.mission: Connecting People. Building Partnerships. Driving Growth.
profile.availability: Remote, on site and international events

experiences.description: Exploring new markets and developing presence across Benin. Building strategic partnerships with universities, student communities, and industry leaders; recruiting ambassador networks, and organizing digital technology and iGaming educational initiatives.
Managed and coordinated a high-performing affiliate management team. Supervised partner onboarding, negotiated bespoke commission structures, monitored traffic quality, and scaled revenues.

Recruited, trained, and led an international team of brand ambassadors across emerging markets. Defined content guidelines, supervised milestone execution, and built enduring professional relationships with creators.
Executed integrated marketing campaigns (digital ads, influencer partnerships, online tournaments) that accelerated player acquisition, game visibility, and brand reach.
Formulated marketing strategies to accelerate brand growth, negotiated partnership activations, and managed competitor benchmarking and audience communications.
Cultivated strategic affiliate relationships, onboarded new traffic sources, and coordinated promotional materials to drive user acquisition.
Localized cryptocurrency documentation, market updates, and UI interfaces from English to French. Collaborated with marketing and community teams to engage francophone traders.

experiences.role: Social Media & Community Manager, Video Editor
experiences.description: Managing and moderating official communities on Telegram, Discord, and X. Gathering player feedback to refine games, producing short-form video campaigns, hosting AMAs, and representing Onlyplay at international industry summits.
Moderated the official French Telegram community, coordinated interactive events, and delivered community insights to product managers.
Fostered a thriving Telegram community, provided real-time user assistance, organized promotional contests, and maintained vigilant anti-scam protection.
Managed and developed NDA's social media presence in sports betting and gaming. Created engaging promotional content, handled player interactions, and supported user retention and community growth.
